caption:
A Filipino tourist dies in Dhaka after suffering burns over 63% of her body in a kitchen fire.

Keistin Var Bunag, a 32-year-old Filipino national, has died after suffering severe burns in a kitchen fire at a flat in Dhaka's Banani.

According to resident doctor Sultan Mahmud Sikder, Bunag passed away at 3:30 am on Monday in the intensive care unit of the National Institute of Burn and Plastic Surgery.

The victim had burns covering 63 percent of her body. She had been receiving advanced treatment at the burn institute after her condition deteriorated.

The incident occurred on the morning of October 28, when Bunag was attempting to light a cylinder gas stove in her flat at House 66, Road No. 7, Banani.

House manager Al Amin reported that the stove suddenly caught fire, leading to the severe injuries.

Bunag had arrived in Bangladesh on a tourist visa on October 15 and was staying in the flat with a Japanese friend, Fumiaki Nakasima.

Habibur Rahman, inspector-in-charge of the Dhaka Medical College Hospital Police Camp, confirmed the death and stated that her body is being kept in the morgue for a postmortem exam.
